race.comment: FIERY LASS (2) broke the maiden status at the Sunny Coast last time out and will have derived a stack of confidence from that breakthrough victory. Winning rider Brooker retains the mount and can go back-to-back without surprising. BRUTAL LASS (6) is a bit hit or miss but gets in well at the weights with the claim and is capable enough on her day. Worth including in calculations. VOSTOKOVA (1) didn't handle the shifting surface last time but the two runs prior to start the campaign were full of merit. Worth another chance. CONSTANT CAFE (7) best of the rest in a race with only a handful of hopes.
